endpoints.description: Detect anomalies in time-series metrics — spikes, drops, trend breaks, and seasonal deviations
Evaluate system health against thresholds and SLAs with time-to-breach estimation
Detect and classify incidents by correlating events and identifying root causes
Generate optimized alerting rules with thresholds, escalation paths, and noise reduction
Calculate uptime, MTTR, MTBF, and SLA compliance from event history
Establish performance baselines with normal ranges and threshold recommendations
5-Whys root cause analysis for incidents with corrective and preventive actions
Forecast future capacity needs and days-until-limit with scaling recommendations
Gate monitoring actions and remediations based on change windows and system health
